gates.evidence: The exact 6331b0a runtime passed with one renderer and a 201-entity interactive deck from 177 source features: 194 factual entities plus 7 mapped gaps. The evidence browser retained all 249 records (206 factual and 43 gaps), the Guided First Orbit stayed inside that denied runtime, and review_status remains not_reviewed while production_runtime_release remains false.

The normal, source-gap, and controlled candidate-503 routes kept the public language truthful: the persistent rank disclosure says magnitude is not performance; source gaps expose no estimate; commitments and performance remain unassessed; and the tutorial never implied release, score, or deploy authority.

Rendered evidence showed China as rank 1 at 15,000 MtCO2e/yr while a persistent visible and accessible disclosure identifies the ranking as emissions magnitude, not performance. A source-gap card presented no numeric estimate and remained unranked, not scored, and missing a reviewed source.

The selected factual card exposed its labelled 2014-2023 chart, Year/Value/Unit table, Source & methodology, canonical PRIMAP-hist v2.6.1 DOI, harmonized-estimate accounting frame, LULUCF exclusion, inventory distinction, and uncertainty limitation.

The exact runtime retained labelled rank controls, a modal country card with focused heading, named chart and table, source and limits, explicit factual-versus-source-gap statuses, and a complete 249-record evidence view. The tutorial adds a named completion control inside the active country dialog and announces the evidence-unavailable suppression state.

Live keyboard review verified heading focus, forward and reverse Tab containment, arrow navigation with heading focus retained, and visible opener restoration. On tutorial step three, Tab moves from Close directly to the in-dialog Explore freely control; closing early returns safely to country selection without a stale transition.

The inherited 44px control contract remained intact across the reviewed runtime, and mobile review found the tutorial actions, replay control, country Close control, and in-dialog completion control visible, operable, unclipped, and separated from the globe dock.

The exact tutorial and country-dialog flow was exercised at mobile width without horizontal overflow or overlap. The overlay, replay control, persistent magnitude disclosure, Close control, and in-dialog completion action remained readable and operable throughout the three-step path.

At a 640x400 CSS-pixel viewport with device scale factor 2, the selected card was contained at 540x262, measured zero horizontal overflow and zero header/control overlap, retained usable content scrolling (260px client height, 502px scroll height), and kept 44px minimum targets.

The exact checked-in headless lifecycle waited for the dynamic reduced-motion preference transition and verified autoRotate false at entry, while selected, after close, and after the preference change; reduced-motion animations remained disabled without the prior immediate race.

Fresh computed-style measurements of the now-opaque return control passed WCAG AA: dark rgb(78, 205, 196) on rgb(10, 11, 18) measured 10.148:1, and light rgb(31, 94, 70) on rgb(250, 247, 240) measured 7.143:1. The control was visible and unclipped at 1280x800 and 375x720 with a visible focus indicator.

A fresh 1280x800 forced-colors context with three custom-font requests blocked kept the return control, rank rail, country modal controls and statuses, selected aria-current state, factual China state, source-gap ATF state, and focus indicators distinguishable and operable without color alone; no control was hidden or clipped and horizontal overflow was zero.

The exact lifecycle rendered one WebGL canvas with the 201-entity deck and 177-feature geometry. It retained the pinned 3600x1800 image/jpeg NASA surface and 4096x2048 image/png Three-Globe sky, including paths, flipY, sky mesh, and a one-renderer lifecycle under the v40 service-worker epoch.

Controlled candidate-503 testing kept the tutorial suppressed, exposed the accessible evidence-unavailable route, and never constructed a misleading tutorial step. Geometry, image, timeout, cancellation, WebGL-loss, retry, and recovery behavior remained covered by the inherited pinned runtime checks; the dependent deterministic rollback proof is intentionally refreshed after this exact UI attestation.

A same-origin browser session on exact commit 6331b0a returned SmokeTest 25 of 25 with failed 0 and criticalFailed 0, including all three guided-orbit guards. StackLint returned an empty issue list, and targeted lifecycle review found no duplicate handlers, hidden focus restoration, or stale completion control.
